In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

1. Relocation of Street Dogs

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

1. Relocation of Street Dogs

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

1. Relocation of Street Dogs

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

1. Relocation of Street Dogs

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

Staff Remarks:
In accordance with the directions of the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and the provisions of the Animal Birth Control (ABC) Rules, 2023, the following guidelines are hereby issued for the information of the public and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs):

1. Relocation of Street Dogs

Street dogs shall not be relocated from their respective territorial areas. Any relocation is strictly prohibited under the Supreme Court’s orders and the ABC Rules, 2023.



2. Natural Behaviour of Dogs

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.

Barking, crying, chasing and other such activities are part of the natural instincts of dogs. These behaviours cannot be restricted or treated as nuisance under law.



3. Animal Birth Control (ABC) Programme

BBMP shall undertake sterilisation and immunisation of street dogs in accordance with the ABC Rules, 2023. Citizens are requested to cooperate with BBMP officials during the implementation of this programme.



4. Public Cooperation

Citizens are advised not to harm or relocate street dogs. Any such action is unlawful and liable for action under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960 and other applicable laws.
